narration:0:1525607001:1.text: Morning comes, and you return to the fields.
narration:0:1525607001:1.male: Morning comes, and you return to the fields.
narration:0:1525607001:1.female: Morning comes, and you return to the fields.

narration:1:1525607002:1.text: Nothing's come up. The soil's still bare.

say:3:1525607003:1.source_cn: 派翁老师的植物净化药剂也没起作用……

choice_prompt:4:1525607003.source_cn: 派翁老师的植物净化药剂也没起作用……

say:5:1525607004:1.text: If magic doesn't work, what are we supposed to do now? What will happen to the bitter corn?
say:5:1525607004:1.source_cn: 连魔法在神力面前也发挥不了作用……那接下来苦苞穗的改良...

say:7:1525607005:1.text: Don't lose heart, Zan. Your work did make a difference.
say:7:1525607005:1.source_cn: 别灰心，扎莱。你的改良工作绝非毫无效果。

say:8:1525607006:1.text: Before the God of Harvest returned, Halia benefited from the improvements you made to the crops. And we all saw it just now—the bitter corn really was purified.
say:8:1525607006:1.source_cn: 至少在丰饶神回来之前，呼临城看到了你的成果。

say:9:1525607007:1.text: Paeon's potion works, which means his approach was right, and so was yours. The problem isn't the crop or the potion. It's the god standing in your way.
say:9:1525607007:1.source_cn: 而且我们都能感受到苦苞穗的确被净化了。派翁的药剂有效，...

say:10:1525607008:1.text: <style="highlight">Once the fallen god is gone, the curse will be gone with him.</style> Both the Arcane Council and Halia are working toward that day.
say:10:1525607008:1.source_cn: 等到<style=highlight>堕神彻底陨落之时...

choice_prompt:11:1525607008.text: <style="highlight">Once the fallen god is gone, the curse will be gone with him.</style> Both the Arcane Council and Halia are working toward that day.
choice_prompt:11:1525607008.source_cn: 等到<style=highlight>堕神彻底陨落之时，诅咒一定会解开</style>。魔法师协会和呼临城都在为此努力。

say:12:1525607009:1.text: I wish I knew magic myself... I'd go with you and help bring that fallen god down.
say:12:1525607009:1.source_cn: 要是我也会魔法就好了……那就能和你们一起去打败堕神了。
say:12:1525607009:1.male: I wish I knew magic myself... I'd go with you and help bring that fallen god down.
say:12:1525607009:1.female: I wish I knew magic myself... I'd go with you and help bring that fallen god down.

choice_prompt:13:1525607009.text: I wish I knew magic myself... I'd go with you and help bring that fallen god down.
choice_prompt:13:1525607009.source_cn: 要是我也会魔法就好了……那就能和你们一起去打败堕神了。
choice_prompt:13:1525607009.male: I wish I knew magic myself... I'd go with you and help bring that fallen god down.
choice_prompt:13:1525607009.female: I wish I knew magic myself... I'd go with you and help bring that fallen god down.

say:14:1525607010:1.text: Magic is powerful, but it's not an answer to everything. Knowing the land, studying the world, learning from the past... that's how people survive disasters.
say:14:1525607010:1.source_cn: 魔法固然强大，但这个世界也并非力量至上。穷理格物，博古...

say:15:1525607011:1.text: When the fallen god is gone and Halia knows peace again, we can use our experience to warn those who come after us. Maybe I'll even start a small scholarly society to record everything that happened...
say:15:1525607011:1.source_cn: 待堕神消逝，呼临恢复平静，我们可以以自身的经历警醒后人...

say:16:1525607012:1.text: Then please let me join you when that time comes. I want Paeon's teachings to live on.
say:16:1525607012:1.source_cn: 那么到时候请一定要带上我。我想将派翁老师的知识继续传承下去。

say:17:1525607013:1.text: Of course. He was a dear friend of mine. He's gone now, but his work deserves to be remembered.
say:17:1525607013:1.source_cn: 当然。派翁是我的挚友，即便他已经逝去，但他的名声值得更...

say:18:1525607014:1.text: How about this: We name the society after the plant he loved most—the <style="highlight">Evergreen</style>. What do you think?
say:18:1525607014:1.source_cn: ……不如这样，我们创建的学会，就以他最喜爱的植物——<...

say:19:1525607015:1.text: Really?! That would be such an honor for Paeon... and for me!
say:19:1525607015:1.source_cn: 真的可以吗？！这是派翁老师和我的荣幸！

choice:13:0:1.text: It takes more than magic to beat a god.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 战胜堕神，可不能只靠魔法
choice:13:0:1.male: It takes more than magic to beat a god.
choice:13:0:1.female: It takes more than magic to beat a god.

choice:11:0:1.text: Yeah, he'll be gone sooner or later!
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 没错，丰饶神迟早会陨落！
choice:11:0:1.male: Yeah, he'll be gone sooner or later!
choice:11:0:1.female: Yeah, he'll be gone sooner or later!

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 耐心等待，会有那么一天的

choice:4:0:1.text: Not surprising. It's a god's curse.
choice:4:0:1.male: Not surprising. It's a god's curse.
choice:4:0:1.female: Not surprising. It's a god's curse.
